content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking for guidance on how to connect two identical sensors. Currently, I have a [product_name] and one [product_name] analog expansion module. Here is one of the sensors: [url], [url]. The sensor is a 2-wire type with 4-20mA, 24VDC and will be used for water level measurement.

For the first channel of the analog module, connect the +24VDC from the module’s power supply to the red wire of the sensor. The blue wire should be connected to terminal I1 on the analog module. Link M1 of the module with M from the module’s power supply.
Thank you [user_name]. For the second sensor, should I follow the same method but use I2 and M2, as shown in the pictures?
Correct. The L+ and M terminals are internally connected on the module.
